description: Controlled combat identity gauntlet; not human campaign win rates.
revision: Capped protection; spent level-scaled Bash; Steady stun recovery; equal hero faces; class combo bonuses; class-aware recovery density.
scenario: Four encounters per floor (three ordinary, one guardian); recruits on floors 3 and 5; one well/floor before guardian; no items, equipment, artefacts, gold shops, travel, loot points or rare personal saves. AI edits and actor selection, not perfect human play.
seedPolicy: Same numeric seeds and starter/temperament for each lesson rank; full configuration applies rank five to every family. The middle configuration alternates ranks 2 and 3 across the eight families: exactly 20 of 40 lesson ranks, not half the gold cost. Different actions consume different RNG draws.
